name: AV_Odyssey_Bench_LMMs_Eval
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating large multimodal models (LMMs) on audio-visual and image+text reasoning tasks. It measures models' abilities on visual question answering, multimodal reasoning, and descriptive tasks combining visual inputs with text prompts.
reputation: A newer evaluation collection targeting LMMs; gaining attention among multimodal model evaluators but not yet a broadly established standard.
